lines.en: I shift forward an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 我的动作很慢，但没有停。
lines.en: I'm slow, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 关节像锈住了，走起来很硬。
lines.en: My joints move as if rusted, stiffly.
I come slowly out of the shadow.
My steps sound like hammered iron.
One step takes me a long while.
I drag my legs forward.
I haven't stopped; I'm merely slow.
I turn in from the doorway.
My head lifts slowly.
I round the pillar and head for the center.
I stand, like a machine switched off.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，也没有声响。
lines.en: I don't move and make no sound.
Dust has filled my armor seams.
My head hangs low.
A light slides across my face.

lines.zh: 我停摆很久了，可甲还在。
lines.en: I've been still a long time, but the armor remains.

lines.zh: 我瘦长的影子投在墙上。
lines.en: My thin, tall shadow falls on the wall.
Nothing in me is turning.
I'm tall and thin.
You stand before me, and I don't move.
You aren't my destination.
I am like an object left in the wrong place.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我没有回看。
lines.en: While you look at me, I don't look back.
This armor is heavy.
I don't attack, and I don't defend.
You may come closer if you like.
My movements take time.

lines.zh: 你听到的全部声音是我。
lines.en: Every sound you hear is me.
I neither retreat nor answer.
The lamp flickered and steadied.
A joint has slipped one notch.
This damage doesn't stop me running.
There's no pain, only a log entry.
My movements are slower now.
I'll keep going.

lines.zh: 敲吧，铁皮只是响了一声。
lines.en: Knock away—the plating just rings.
I've shut down. Don't touch me.
Put that away.
It's of no use to me.

lines.zh: 我停在这里不是等吃的。
lines.en: I'm not standing here for food.
That won't tempt me.
There's only iron and wire inside.
I have no response.
What are you waving? I can't be bothered to move.
Your shoulder bounced off.
Your push shifted me slightly.

lines.zh: 我被撞偏，缓缓转回原向。
lines.en: Knocked aside, I slowly turn back on course.
My armor is thick and cold.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我已经忘了。
lines.en: By the time you stepped back, I'd forgotten.
We're both jammed in the doorway.
You touched one of my joints.
It didn't respond to you.
I stood my ground and didn't yield.

lines.zh: 我上次被启动是很久以前。
lines.en: The last time I was started was long ago.
Nobody gives me orders.

lines.zh: 我等着一个不会来的命令。
lines.en: I wait for an order that won't come.
The space beside me is empty.
I'd know the sound of my own kind.
Only my shadow is here.
I can't recall who it was.
I don't look for companions.
Switched off, we're all the same.
I can reach what's on the ground.
I recognize this alloy.
I slot it into my chest.
This isn't one of my parts.
I pick it up and study it a long while.
It's been on the ground a long time.
I put it back down.
I can't remember whose it was.

lines.zh: 一只手抬起来，用了一刻钟。
lines.en: One hand lifts, taking a quarter hour.
This isn't an order.
My feet have started moving.
I'm facing that direction.
I don't shout, and I give no warning.
This one isn't on the list.
It took me a long time to decide.
My actions have a delay.
I've shifted my weight across.
This is startup.

lines.zh: 我准备好了，只是还没动。
lines.en: I am ready — I just have not moved.

lines.zh: 我的朝向锁着你，脚步很慢。
lines.en: My facing locks on you; my steps are slow.

lines.zh: 你走多快，我的视线就有多慢。
lines.en: However fast you go, my gaze is slower.
I'm not speeding up.
I don't chase; I only walk there.
I can hear your breathing.

lines.zh: 我的关节一格一格地动。
lines.en: My joints move one notch at a time.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我仍在半途。
lines.en: You back to the corner; I am still mid-stride.
You've gone behind the pillar.

lines.zh: 我一直在前进，没有停过。
lines.en: I keep advancing and have not stopped.
I've measured the distance.

lines.zh: 你的速度对我没有意义。
lines.en: Your speed means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，所以不会先累。
lines.en: I do not breathe, so I will not tire first.
You will tire before I do.

lines.zh: 你听到的声响是我在走。
lines.en: That sound you hear is me walking.
Three tiles of distance left.
You have no other exit.
My speed isn't fast.
I raise a hand and let it fall.
My fist is heavy.
You didn't block it.
I put my whole weight behind it.

lines.zh: 这一下之后我停了一会。
lines.en: After that I stopped for a while.

lines.zh: 我的动作太慢，你闪开了。
lines.en: I'm too slow; you slipped away.

lines.zh: 我的甲撞在你的护甲上。
lines.en: My armor clashed with yours.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我还没抬完手。
lines.en: You backed three steps; my arm is not up yet.

lines.zh: 另一只手抬到一半，停住了。
lines.en: My other hand rises halfway and stops.
That strike came without a cry.

lines.zh: 我砸在地面上，土都裂了。
lines.en: I struck the ground and it split.
You ran before my hand came down.
I need a moment after that.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，等你走进范围。
lines.en: I stand here, waiting for you to enter range.
My arm falls back to my side.
I turn and walk away slowly.
It's finished now.
I'm standing still, and then I move.
Something has switched me on.

lines.zh: 有什么在我的眼框里亮起来了。
lines.en: Something has lit inside my eye sockets.
It took me a while to recognize this place.

lines.zh: 这里的地面比记忆里冷。
lines.en: The floor here is colder than I remember.

lines.zh: 停摆的机关，头先抬起来。
lines.en: A stalled mechanism lifts its head first.
I hear my own joints creak.
I straighten up out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 我在这里等下一个指令。
lines.en: I'll wait here for the next order.
There's a draft; this place is open.

lines.zh: 我的手从身侧抬起一点。
lines.en: My hand lifts a little from my side.
My shadow lies long on the floor.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，慢慢变热。
lines.en: Fire heats my armor slowly.
I hit the floor with a loud clang.
Water gets into my seams and I grow heavier.
The blast slides me across the floor.

lines.zh: 东西打在我甲上，弹开了。
lines.en: Something strikes my armor and ricochets.
Light runs wild through my joints.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我正在停摆。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I'm winding down.

lines.zh: 雷过我的全身，我停了一拍。
lines.en: Lightning crosses me and I miss a beat.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我的重量无处放。
lines.en: No floor here; my weight has nowhere to go.
